artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers $b,c$ and a nonnegative integer $n$, let the generalized central trinomial coefficient $T_n(b,c)$ be the coefficient of $x^n$ in $(x^2+bx+c)^n$, and write $T_n = T_n(1,1)$. Let $C_k = \binom{2k}{k}/(k+1)$ denote the $k$-th Catalan number, and let $\left(\tfrac{\cdot}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol.

Prove or disprove the following statements for every prime $p>3$.

(i) The following congruences hold:
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{12^k}T_k \equiv \left(\tfrac{p}{3}\right)\frac{p-1+3}{4}\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{16^k}T_{2k}(4,1)\equiv 1\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{C_k}{16^k}T_{2k}(4,1)\equiv 4\!\left(\!\left(\tfrac{3}{p}\right)-p\!\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\!\right)\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{4^k}T_{2k}(3,4)\equiv \left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\frac{7-3p}{4}\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{16^k}T_{2k}(8,9)\equiv \left(\tfrac{3}{p}\right)\pmod{p^2}.$$

(ii) Moreover,
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{16^k}T_{2k}(2,3)\equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{16^k}T_{2k}(4,-3)\equiv \begin{cases}\left(\tfrac{-1}{p}\right)\!\left(2x-\tfrac{p}{2x}\right)\pmod{p^2} & \text{if } p\equiv 1\pmod 3,\ p=x^2+3y^2,\ 3\mid x-1,\\ 0\pmod{p} & \text{if } p\equiv 2\pmod 3;\end{cases}$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{4^k}T_{2k}(1,-3)\equiv \begin{cases}(-1)^{xy/2}\,2x\pmod{p} & \text{if } p=x^2+3y^2,\ 3\mid x-1,\\ 0\pmod{p} & \text{if } p\equiv 2\pmod 3;\end{cases}$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{16^k}T_{2k}(4,3)\equiv \begin{cases}(-1)^{(p-1)/4-\lfloor x/6\rfloor}\,2x\pmod{p} & \text{if } p\equiv 1\pmod{12},\ p=x^2+3y^2,\ 4\mid x-1,\\ (-1)^{y/2-1}\!\left(\tfrac{xy}{3}\right)\!2y\pmod{p} & \text{if } p\equiv 5\pmod{12},\ p=x^2+3y^2,\ 4\mid x-1,\\ 0\pmod{p} & \text{if } p\equiv 3\pmod 4.\end{cases}$$
artifact.status_search_result: Zhi-Wei Sun has a series of papers conjecturing and proving supercongruences involving generalized central trinomial coefficients $T_n(b,c)$, including a 2014 paper in Science China Math and a 2020 preprint "Supercongruences for central trinomial coefficients." Several such conjectures have been proved (often via the Wilf–Zeilberger method or modular forms), but I could not locate a definitive reference confirming that all of the specific congruences in this list have been established. The status is therefore inconclusive from available sources.
